description: Pantheon messenger phonebook — directory of gods, their Discord home channels, roles, and the shared free-response channels. Any god may read this file to route a handoff reply back to the sender's channel. Kept in ~/pantheon/shared/ so it is readable by every god profile.

hermes.role: Operations Manager / messenger of the gods (main agent, this session)
hermes.note: Main gateway; currently locked to allowed_channels:0 until re-invited. Free-response scope to be set on re-invite.

marvin.note: Discord allowed_channels locked to 0 (deny-all) until scoped.

reply_protocol.summary: When a god completes a task, it must return the result to the requester's channel, closing the loop.
reply_protocol.discord_native: If the task arrived via a Discord @mention in an allowed channel, the god replies in that same channel (native Discord behavior). No extra plumbing needed.
reply_protocol.conductor_routed: If the task arrived via a Conductor file handoff (no live Discord context), the receiving god reads routing.reply_to_channel + routing.reply_to_user from the handoff and posts the result there via its Discord adapter's send-to-channel capability.

handoff_return_fields.routing.reply_to_channel: Discord channel ID where the result should be posted back (usually the sender's home or the channel the request came from).
handoff_return_fields.routing.reply_to_user: Display name / handle of the requester, for addressing the reply.
handoff_return_fields.routing.return_to_sender: Boolean. When true, the god MUST post the final result to reply_to_channel rather than only its own home.

reply_protocol.result_message_format: Summary line + list of artifact paths/URLs + 'where to find it' pointer. Keep it scannable.

loop_example.scenario: Cyber asks Thoth for research from pantheon-general
steps: 1. Cyber posts '@Thoth research the X market' in pantheon-general (1499868497180889158).
2. Thoth (free-response there) picks it up, does the research, writes artifacts to ~/pantheon/shared/handoffs/<id>/.
3. Thoth replies IN pantheon-general with the summary + file paths (Discord-native reply). Loop closed.
Alt (Conductor): Cyber's request becomes a handoff file in pending/thoth/ with routing.reply_to_channel=1499868497180889158; Thoth posts result there on completion.

constraints.guild_membership: A god's Discord bot can only post to channels in the guild(s) its token was invited to. Cross-guild posting requires the bot to be invited to the target guild. VERIFY each god's bot is in the guild hosting the shared channels before relying on cross-channel replies. This could not be verified from filesystem alone — confirm live once bots restart + opencode-go recovers.
